induction_scope: RT domain theory and provisional QM-GR bridge seed

primary_hypothesis.statement: Continuity and discreteness need not compete because they may be domain-dominated primitive realizations of one universal primitive under different domain conditions.

universal_primitive.constraint: not identical to any one domain-dominated realization

domain_dominated_primitive.constraint: primitive within D does not imply universally primitive

consequences: domain distinction cannot be lawfully annihilated
minimum admissible distinction remains relationally realized
zero is excluded rather than occupied as a state

qm_gr_seed.D_QM: indexed distinction and admissible relational continuation

analogy_controls: no quantum mechanics interpretation is established
no quantum gravity derivation is claimed
exclusions_preserved: continuity and discreteness as two substances

formal_obligations.name: Domain typing criterion
formal_obligations.requirement: Define when regimes are different domains rather than descriptions, scales, or resolutions.

formal_obligations.name: Projection law
formal_obligations.requirement: Define what Π_D preserves, transforms, gains, loses, or excludes.

formal_obligations.name: Cross-domain invariant
formal_obligations.requirement: Identify an invariant carried through both projections.

formal_obligations.name: Operator derivation
formal_obligations.requirement: Determine the lawful x in RT_cd; <=>_r remains unproven.

formal_obligations.name: Same-domain conflict test
formal_obligations.requirement: Test continuity/discreteness conflict in one fully typed domain without arbitrary domain splitting.

formal_obligations.name: Physical bridge restraint
formal_obligations.requirement: Keep QM-GR mapping provisional until standard physical or formal structures are connected.

predictions: A system may admit continuity-dominated internal description and discreteness-dominated external indexing when domains are independently typed.
Apparent contradictions may decompose into domain, orientation, admissibility, observable, or degree-of-freedom differences.
Cases without lawful decomposition are genuine tests rather than automatic confirmation.
A lawful domain boundary preserves positive distinction at minimum admissible distinction.
failure_conditions: Independently typed projections remain contradictory solely because they arise from different domains.
No invariant or projection law distinguishes common primitive projection from analogy.
Every counterexample is resolved only by retrospective domain reclassification.
RT_cd adds no lawful structure beyond repetition.
A physically realized case requires D(D_c|D_d) = 0 under the framework semantics.
canonical_induction_text: Induct the hypothesis that continuity and discreteness need not compete universally. Let P_0 denote the single universal primitive, D a typed domain, and P_D := Π_D(P_0) a primitive that dominates within D without becoming universally primitive. Let D_c be continuity-dominated and D_d discreteness-dominated. Their lawful distinction is evaluated by D(D_c|D_d), which cannot resolve as realized zero under the RT core statement. At minimum admissible distinction, the condition remains relationally realized through D(D_c|D_d) <*>_x D(D_c|D_d) =: RT_cd. The operator slot <*>_x is arbitrary and typed; <=>_r is one member of that family but is not established as required. All QM-GR interpretations remain provisional support rather than independent claims.
capture_limitations: Chat semantic capture is not a byte-exact file replica.
The capture preserves the received hypothesis, constraints, obligations, predictions, exclusions, and bridge limitations for controlled intake; formal definitions and validation remain open.
No physical QM-GR claim is promoted.
